```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

<!-- Arrange the order of the regions after the media price 2025 -->
```{r}
#Change the df so that it will be displayed in thousant SEK instead + calculate percentage difference. It shows how much higher or lower the mean price is relative to the median.
brf_lan_tidy <- brf_lan_tidy |>
  mutate(mean_price_mkr = mean_price / 1e6,
    median_price_mkr = median_price / 1e6,
    diff_pct = (mean_price_mkr - median_price_mkr) /
      median_price_mkr * 100)
#Arrange the order of the regions after the media price 2025
region_order <- brf_lan_tidy |>
  filter(year == 2025) |>
  arrange(median_price_mkr) |>
  pull(region)
#Apply the new region order
brf_lan_tidy <- brf_lan_tidy |>
    mutate(region = factor(region, levels = region_order)) 
```

<!-- Dumbbell plot -->
```{r}
p <- ggplot(brf_lan_tidy, aes(y = region)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = median_price_mkr, xend = mean_price_mkr, yend = region, frame = year),
    colour = "grey") +
  
  geom_point(aes(
    x = median_price_mkr, 
    colour = "Median", 
    frame = year,
    text = paste(region,
           paste("Median:", median_price_mkr, "million SEK"),
           paste("Mean:", mean_price_mkr, "million SEK"),
           paste("Difference:", round(diff_pct), "%"),
           sep = "<br>")), size = 2) +
  
  geom_point(aes(
    x = mean_price_mkr, 
    colour = "Mean", 
    frame = year, text = paste(region,
           paste("Median:", median_price_mkr, "million SEK"),
           paste("Mean:", mean_price_mkr, "million SEK"),
           paste("Difference:", round(diff_pct), "%"),
           sep = "<br>")), size = 2) +

    labs(title = "Mean vs. median price",
    subtitle = "Absolut difference in price",
    x = "Price (in million SEK)",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL) +

    scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
    "Median" = "steelblue",
    "Mean" = "darkorange")) +

    scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 5, 0.5)) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right")
```

<!-- Convert to Plotly + add timeline + remove play-button -->
```{r}
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  animation_slider(
    currentvalue = list(
      prefix = "Year: ")) |> 

animation_button(
    visible = FALSE
  )
```
